_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost...

description:
Best for: "what will import duty and VAT be on this?" for one item shipped to the UK or US from a known tariff line.
Returns: duty (the general rate plus US chapter 99 extra duties when they match), VAT, US fees and total, all in the input currency, with each chapter 99 heading, rate and reason, the headings skipped, sources and date. complete is true only when every part was worked out; a rate that is not a plain percentage comes back as text with no amount.
Input tips: hs_code is a full line (UK 10 digits, US 8 or 10), such as "6109100010"; copy the code field from bulk_hs_candidates and narrow a short code first. Send destination, goods_value and shipping in one currency. For the US also send origin (2 letters) and transport.
Not for: the EUR 3 EU low-value duty (use eu_duty_estimate). For destination EU, duty rates are not looked up, so only VAT is calculated (send country).

country.description: EU member state for the VAT rate, such as DE (EU destination)

destination.description: Where the goods are imported: "UK", "US" or "EU". EU duty is not looked up, only VAT.

goods_value.description: Value of the goods, such as 80, in the one currency used for every amount (no conversion is done).

hs_code.description: A full tariff line, UK 10 digits or US 8 or 10 digits, dots allowed, such as "6109100010". Copy it from bulk_hs_candidates. A candidate, not binding.

origin.description: 2-letter country the goods come from. Required for a complete US landed cost, so chapter 99 duties can be applied.

shipping.description: Shipping and insurance to the destination, such as 12, in the same currency. Send 0 if none.

transport.description: How the goods travel into the US. ocean adds the harbor fee (0.125%). air and other add none. Required for a complete US landed cost.

name: landed_cost_estimate

chapter_99.description: US only: extra chapter 99 duties that were added. They are already counted in duty; do not add them again.

reason.description: Why the heading was added or skipped.

chapter_99_skipped.description: US only: chapter 99 headings that matched but were not added, each with the reason.

reason.description: Why the heading was added or skipped.

complete.description: false when a part could not be worked out; then say what missing or notes list.

duty.description: Duty in the input currency. amount is null when the rate is not a plain percentage. For the US, rate and amount already include the chapter_99 lines that were added.

basis.description: The value the rate applies to, or "not calculated".

rate.description: The rate applied. With chapter 99 lines it reads like 16.5% general + 20% chapter 99 = 36.5%.

fees.description: US only: merchandise processing fee (MPF) and harbor fee (HMF).

hs_status.description: Always a candidate code, not a binding classification.

missing.description: What is missing when complete is false.

total.description: Goods, shipping, duty, fees and VAT, in the input currency. Leaves out parts that are null.

vat.description: VAT in the input currency, on goods, shipping and duty. 0 for the US.

title: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost
